card.name: Social psychology and behavior passages
card.fires_on: Small words and punctuation in general-web passages about social influence, conformity, persuasion and anxiety disorders, often right before a statement about what people do or tend to do.

modes.label: Influence principles
modes.description: The word People or a colon after a named persuasion principle such as social proof or reciprocity.
